title: skills data-hooks.md: the api.transaction row says "commit on return, rollback on throw" unconditionally, while a nested transaction() inside a write door's unit joins it and its return commits nothing
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsS4GoHCgYwA2uv3n3C

Filing gate: class b, an out-of-scope finding of the #34504 dev round (PR #34964, report 6959003049), read by that dev; not measured. ⛔ Not a claim. Grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

Suggested-grade: p2 · the same family as #34504 (a skills follow-up of #34412)

## 维护者速读

- 现象：技能 `data-hooks.md` 的 Capabilities 表里，`api.transaction` 一行写着「返回即提交、抛错即回滚」，没有任何条件;但 `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx` 写的是：嵌套的 `transaction()` 会并入外层事务，它返回时并不提交。钩子里吞掉内层抛错的写法，就会以为内层已回滚、外层已提交，实际不是。
- 为什么要修:AI 照这一行写钩子，会写出「以为提交了」或「以为回滚了」的代码。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## What

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, Capabilities table, `api.transaction` row: "commit on return, rollback on throw", with no condition.
- `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx` (governing text after PR #34503): "A nested transaction() joins the outer unit, so its return is no commit."
- PR #34503's record of its dogfood red at abe9374566 (`scoped-transaction-late-write`): a swallowed inner rollback kept its row.

## Done when

The row states when `api.transaction` joins an outer transaction (inside a write door's unit, or a caller's) and what its return and throw then mean, worded from `hooks.mdx`. One eval exercises it.

Seam: skills `data-hooks.md` (Capabilities, `api.transaction`) → runtime `ScopedContext.transaction` joining the write door's unit (`packages/objectql`).

Dedupe: `api.transaction data-hooks` (open hits listed in the seat's filing comment).
